sections.title: मूलभूत अवधारणा (Ultra Hard)
sections.content: Level 3 में हम advanced Time & Work problems को कवर करते हैं जिनमें multiple workers with varying efficiencies, fractional work, sequential and alternating tasks, pipes & cistern, और wages के proportional distribution शामिल हैं। इन समस्याओं में अक्सर 3–5 step calculations और logical reasoning की आवश्यकता होती है।

sections.title: कार्यक्षमता (Efficiency) – उन्नत
sections.content: Efficiency = 1 / समय (days)। अगर worker A, B से d गुना तेज़ है, तो उसकी efficiency = d × B की efficiency। Multiple worker problems में सभी workers की efficiency अलग-अलग होती है।

sections.title: संयुक्त और क्रमिक कार्य (Combined & Sequential Work)
sections.content:
• Combined Work: सभी workers की rate जोड़ें, समय = total work ÷ combined rate।
• Sequential Work: अलग-अलग समय segments के लिए partial work निकालें, फिर जोड़कर पूरा कार्य = 1।
• Alternate work: workers alternate days काम करें, प्रत्येक day partial work जोड़ें।

sections.title: Fractional Work (अंश कार्य)
sections.content:
यदि कोई कार्य पहले दिन का fraction पूरा हो गया, तो शेष work = 1 - done fraction।
शेष कार्य पूरा करने का समय = remaining work ÷ combined rate।

sections.title: Pipes & Cistern (उन्नत)
sections.content:
• Filling pipe rate = 1 / fill time, Emptying pipe rate = 1 / empty time (negative)।
• Net rate = sum of all filling rates - sum of emptying rates
• Total time = total work ÷ net rate
• Fractional filling/emptying पर ध्यान दें।

sections.title: Wages & Work Linkage (उन्नत)
sections.content:
मजदूरी proportional होती है to individual work done।
• Individual share = individual work ÷ total work × total wages
• यदि efficiency अलग-अलग हो तो share = individual rate × time segment।

sections.title: महत्वपूर्ण सूत्र (Formulas)
sections.content:
1. Efficiency = 1 / Time
2. Combined rate = sum of all efficiencies
3. Fractional work: Remaining ÷ rate
4. Sequential/Alternate work: Segment-wise partial works
5. Pipes: net rate = fill rate - empty rate
6. Wages = proportional to work done
7. Time = total work ÷ net rate

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
• Sequential work में partial works जोड़ना भूल जाना
• Pipes में ± का ध्यान न रखना
• Multiple workers की efficiency गलत लेना
• Fractional work के लिए wrong fraction लेना
• Wages calculation में proportionality भूल जाना

sections.title: सारांश
sections.content:
• Efficiency और Time का उल्टा अनुपात
• Combined + Sequential work: segment-wise calculation
• Fractional work: remaining ÷ rate
• Pipes: net rate, ± ध्यान
• Wages: proportional to work done
• Multi-step problems में हर step logically solve करें

tricks.title: Multiple Worker Rate Shortcut
tricks.explanation: सबके rate जोड़ें, total work ÷ combined rate = total time

tricks.title: Sequential Work Shortcut
tricks.explanation: हर segment का partial work निकालें, जोड़ें, पूरा कार्य =1
tricks.example: A 2 दिन, B 3 दिन, A+2, B+3 segment-wise जोड़कर total work =1।

tricks.title: Fractional Work Trick
tricks.explanation: पहले से पूरा fraction घटाएँ, remaining ÷ rate = time

tricks.title: Pipes & Cistern Trick
tricks.explanation: Net rate = filling rates - emptying rates, time = total ÷ net
tricks.example: Fill 6 दिन, empty 12 दिन, Net rate =1/6-1/12=1/12, Time=12 दिन।

tricks.title: Efficiency Ratio Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Faster worker rate = ratio × slower worker rate

tricks.title: Wages Quick Share
tricks.explanation: Individual share = individual work ÷ total work × total wages

tricks.title: Alternate Day Work Trick
tricks.explanation: Alternate days, हर दिन partial work जोड़ें, total work =1
tricks.example: A,B alternate, A day1 1/4, B day2 1/5, sum until work=1

tricks.title: Multi-step Efficiency Tip
tricks.explanation: Stepwise calculate each segment, then sum partial works
tricks.example: Day1 A+B, Day2 B+C, total work=sum partials
